card.name: The letter X inside abbreviations
card.fires_on: The letters x, X or dx right after a C or D inside an acronym, code or drug-name ending. Seen in CCX, CXCR4, DXA, dx.doi.org, Roman numerals and biologic suffixes like -cix or -kxwh.

modes.description: x in the four-letter suffix added to antibody drug names.
modes.example: 40 mg/mL tafasitamab-c<<x>>ix. Gently swirl the vial

modes.label: DOI link and numerals
modes.description: dx in doi URLs, or X in long Roman numerals.
